content: Tad eva artha matra nirbhasam svarupa shunyam iva samadhih. (Absorption is when awareness shines solely as the object itself, transcending the sense of the meditator).
author: Patanjali
explanation:
In the profound psychology of the Yoga Sutras, Patanjali outlines the systematic roadmap for stilling mental fluctuations into radiant, sovereign stillness.

This teaching (Tad eva artha matra nirbhasam svarupa shunyam iva samadhih. ...) focuses directly on artha and matra. When we clear away reactive illusions and anchor ourselves in timeless principles, the mind recovers its pristine clarity and inner resilience.

True realization is never an abstract intellectual debate—it is an active discipline lived through quiet integrity and conscious presence in everyday moments.
practicalInsight: Apply this teaching on artha today: take a deliberate pause before reacting, align your actions with quiet integrity, and refuse to let transient friction disturb your center.
reflectionPrompt: How can you embody deeper artha and matra in the primary challenge you are navigating right now?
